title: The low-degree sample complexity of clustering Gaussian mixtures with more groups than dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2611.25163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the computational limits of clustering $n$ observations drawn from a mixture of $K$ isotropic Gaussian distributions in $\mathbb R^d$, when the number $K$ of groups is much larger than the dimension $d$. In this regime, distance-based and spectral procedures require a squared separation $\Delta^2$ of order $\sqrt d$. In contrast, tensor-based procedures cluster at a polylogarithmic separation but need a sample size that is a large polynomial of $dK$, and the low-degree lower bounds known for random centers only show that $n$ must exceed $dK^2$.   Focusing on normally distributed centers, we characterize the minimal separation for clustering with low-degree polynomials in the regime $K>d$, through a low-degree lower bound and a matching upper bound, up to subpolynomial factors. translated_title: 组数多于维数的高斯混合聚类问题的低度样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当组数 $K$ 远大于维数 $d$ 时，对从 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中 $K$ 个各向同性高斯分布的混合中抽取的 $n$ 个观测进行聚类的计算极限。在这一机制下，基于距离的方法和谱方法需要量级为 $\sqrt{d}$ 的平方间隔 $\Delta^2$；相比之下，基于张量的方法可以在多对数级间隔下完成聚类，但需要 $dK$ 的大多项式量级的样本量，而目前已知的针对随机中心的低度下界仅表明 $n$ 必须超过 $dK^2$。我们聚焦于正态分布的中心，通过一个低度下界以及在亚多项式因子意义下匹配的上界，刻画了在 $K>d$ 机制下使用低次多项式进行聚类所需的最小间隔。特别地，对于 $K=d^{p/2}$（$p>2$ 为实数），我们证明了恢复聚类结构需要量级为 $K^3 d^{(\lceil p\rceil-p)/2}$ 的样本量。
tldr: 该论文在组数大于维数的设定下，通过低度多项式的下界与匹配的上界，首次精确刻画了高斯混合聚类所需的最小间隔与样本复杂度，例如当 K=d^{p/2}（p>2）时证明需要量级为 K³d^((⌈p⌉−p)/2) 的样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes, via a low-degree lower bound and a matching upper bound, the minimal separation and sample complexity for clustering Gaussian mixtures when the number of groups exceeds the dimension, showing e.g. that for K=d^{p/2} with p>2, a sample size of order K^3 d^{(⌈p⌉−p)/2} is required.
